In Autumn

Arthur Reed Ropes (“Adrian Ross”) (1859–1933)

O
VER
 the grave in the grass,
Dead leaves eddy and play;
Dead leaves, and the wind grieves
All night and day.
Under the grass of the grave,
Lips, that were red, are white;
Dead lips, and the rain drips
All day and night.
